scope.summary: Implement expand-appearance precisely: bake the current appearance stack (multiple fills/strokes, per-row effects, brushes, live corners, live constructs) into concrete geometry and/or raster layers reproducing the rendered result, as the single explicit boundary between non-destructive editing and destructive materialization. Expansion is exactly one history entry and MUST NOT occur implicitly during ordinary edits, save, or export.
acceptance_criteria: expand-appearance bakes to concrete result as one explicit history entry; never implicit
expected_tests: test: expand bakes appearance to geometry/raster reproducing render; one history entry; never implicit on edit/save/export (negative test)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No expand boundary; non-destructive/destructive line blurred; implicit baking risk.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
